event.description: Union closest shared FF-output scalar groups 114 and 180
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,452 parameters at 99.150000%, a +0.150000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 86 prior macro-attempts in this family and 701 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0188/micro-0005 at 1,454 parameters and 99.21%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0186/micro-0001 (normalization-bias pair 8/3 discarded at 98.08%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of the depth-shared feed-forward output map: union flattened coordinates 114 and 180, values -0.0288736690 and -0.0278803911 (difference 9.933e-04), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: residual-stream reconstruction contains near-duplicate scalars distinct from FF-input redundancy, preserving qualification at 1,451 parameters. It is more informative than the next FF-output union (difference 9.978e-04) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test of the complementary FF map. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
